title: Gotrade Daily: After Monday's Rally, US CPI Tonight
summary: Wall Street rebounded hard on Monday. Tonight: October CPI at 8:30 a.m. ET, then AMD, Nvidia, Sea, Boeing and Exxon in focus.
body_markdown:
This report will not include annual figures because of the 2025 government shutdown, according to CNBC.


### Chip stocks after the rally


**AMD ([AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) )** rose 13.3% on Monday, according to the AP. The same day, AMD[announced](https://newsroom.amd.com/news/amd-epyc-expands-leadership-foundation-ai/) that its 5th Gen EPYC processors will be the host CPUs for Google Cloud's TPU 8tx system.


**Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** fell 4.3% after the company said it was investigating a matter involving CEO Jensen Huang, according to the AP. Nvidia's board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.


### Earnings, Boeing and Fed speakers


**Sea Limited ([SE](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/se/) )** reports third-quarter results before the open, and CoreWeave reports after the close,[according to the Nasdaq earnings calendar](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) . **Boeing ([BA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/ba/) )** releases October orders and deliveries at 11 a.m. ET,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/tuesdays-big-stock-stories-whats-likely-to-move-the-market.html) .


Fed Governor Christopher Waller speaks at 4 a.m. ET and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan at 9 a.m. ET, according to CNBC.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


In CNBC's Monday evening update, Dow futures were up 12 points, or 0.02%, S&P 500 futures were up 0.07% and Nasdaq 100 futures were up 0.19%, according to CNBC.


The chip rally carried into Asia on Tuesday: SoftBank Group rose 13.4%, SK Hynix gained 5.2% and Samsung Electronics added 3.9%,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/ai-softbank-sk-hynix-samsung-wall-street-tech-stocks.html) .


## Macro Note 📝


Brent crude fell 5.8% to $92.57 a barrel, while the 10-year Treasury yield edged up to 4.87% from 4.86%, according to the AP.


## Conclusion


Tonight the market tests whether Monday's rally can hold. The October CPI comes at 8:30 a.m. ET, the market opens at 9:30 a.m. ET and Boeing's data follows at 11 a.m. ET.


Chip stocks such as AMD and Nvidia stay in focus after moving in opposite directions on Monday.
